subject: Investor Briefing: deck finalize, OKR gap list & approval timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Investor Briefing: deck finalize, OKR gap list & approval timeline

Team — attaching deck_draft_v3.pptx (PDF attached for non-edit review). We need to close this package for the investor packet next week. Quick callouts and asks: 

Outstanding items (high priority)
- Slide 4 (ARR runway): finalize FY revenue cadence and include the latest retention definition (Finance owns numbers).
- Slide 7 (OKR health): we have two red/amber items (Platform latency and Sales coverage) — need owners to confirm remediation bullets.
- Slide 11 (Customer stories): pick one Dedicated customer quote (ops + cost savings) or remove the slide.
- Slide 15 (Roadmap): compress roadmap to 3 bullets and add fallback plan for Dedicated capacity if we hit provisioning lag.

Timeline
- Please review and send concrete edits by EOD 11/26.
- I plan to circulate a board-ready PDF to Marta (Axis) on 11/30 morning PT.

Owners
- Finance: Vivek — verify numbers and send the finance worksheet by 11/25.
- Product/Platform: Lauren — confirm OKR remediation text + any new charts by 11/26.
- Comms: Laura & Grace — tone + CEO quote (short) by 11/27.

If you see anything that must be removed for confidentiality or legal, flag now. I will reconcile and ship the PDF to board chair Marta on 11/30.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Business Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Investor Briefing: deck finalize, OKR gap list & approval timeline

Jonas — quick pass on tone and a couple micro-edits. Inline below.

On Slide 2 (Executive summary): swap the order so 'growth highlights' appear before 'operational asks' — investors prefer headline ARR momentum up front.

Slide 7 (OKR health): replace the single long paragraph under 'Platform latency' with two bullets: 1) root cause & mitigation; 2) expected ETA to SLO. Keep it short.

Slide 11: I like keeping the Dedicated customer quote if we use anonymized metrics (percent cost reduction, latency improvement). If Legal pushes back, we can note 'customer example' and give aggregated impact instead.

CEO quote: suggested one-liner for CEO folk: "We are focused on predictable performance and sustainable unit economics as the next chapter of product-led growth."

I'll also run a style sweep for the PDF (font sizes, header consistency) once Vivek drops final numbers.

Laura Bennett
VP, Corporate Communications
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Investor Briefing: deck finalize, OKR gap list & approval timeline

Attaching finance_q3.xlsx (stub). Numbers updated for ARR cadence — note change in methodology for ARR recognition (now includes contracted committed ARR for Dedicated). Please pull the new totals on Slide 4; I flagged the line items that moved.

A couple asks from Finance: 
- On the ARR waterfall, annotate which portion is Annualized vs. Committed. Investors will call this out.
- We should include a one-line risk bullet about billing terms for Dedicated customers (multi-year).

If someone else wants the raw bookings export, I can drop it in Drive.

— Vivek
CFO (acting) | Redwood Inference

Attachment: finance_q3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 4 sheets)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Investor Briefing: deck finalize, OKR gap list & approval timeline

Thanks — made two small content requests after reviewing the draft: 

1) OKR health: the pipeline-coverage metric on Slide 7 is stale (we've updated the funnel last week). I can replace that chart but need the updated funnel CSV (Ops/Rev should share by EOD 11/26).

2) Roadmap slide: propose a short 'canary & fallback' bullet for Dedicated (what we will do if provisioning slips): a) extend burst credits for top 5 enterprise customers, b) prioritize warm pool for critical customers, c) communicate SLAs and mitigation plan. This gives board confidence about reliability engineering readiness.

Also, recommend we call out two hires under org slide (Head of Sales Ops, Senior SRE) as 'offers extended' rather than 'open reqs' — better optics.

I'll prepare the updated charts once I have funnel CSV.

— Lauren
Head of Product Strategy
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Investor Briefing: deck finalize, OKR gap list & approval timeline

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Summary of decisions and owners (so we have a single source of truth):

- Finance (Vivek): update Slide 4 with the new ARR waterfall and annotate 'Annualized vs Committed' — deliver by 11/25 (received).
- Product (Lauren): replace pipeline chart (Slide 7) and add canary/fallback bullets on Slide 15 — deliver by EOD 11/26.
- Comms (Laura & Grace): style + CEO quote and final PDF packaging — deliver by 11/27.
- Legal: flag any customer-identifying content by noon 11/27 (looped separately).

I will assemble a board-ready PDF on 11/29 evening PT and send to Marta (Axis) on 11/30 morning PT. Attaching readied-deck-v3.pdf for board eyes; it's a flattened version of the slides with the current redlines. If there are any absolute showstoppers, escalate now.

Forwarding to Marta with a brief cover note.

Jonas Weber
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@axisvc.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T07:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Investor Briefing: board-ready PDF and quick pre-brief?

Marta — forwarding the board-ready PDF for your review (readied-deck-v3.pdf attached). High-level notes: we've tightened the exec summary, reconciled ARR cadence with Finance, and added a short canary/fallback plan for Dedicated capacity.

Would you be available for a 20-minute pre-brief on 11/30 at 10:00 AM PT or 11:30 AM PT? I can run through the highlights and two potential board questions: (1) definition of committed ARR for Dedicated customers, and (2) mitigation plan for provisioning lag.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Business Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: readied-deck-v3.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@axisvc.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Investor Briefing: board-ready PDF and quick pre-brief?

Jonas — received, thank you. 10:00 AM PT works for a short pre-brief. I'll take a look through the PDF this afternoon and flag any high-level items beforehand. Two quick asks for the call: please have Vivek on the line for the ARR definition and have a one-slide talking head on the canary/fallback flow.

See you at 10.

Marta Alvarez
Board Chair | Axis Ventures
